trade.structure: Long 3-month OTM AUDNZD put (delta/strike to be set only after live 3M ATMF IV and 25-delta risk-reversal mids exist). Do not sell the call side as a risk-reversal until skew is observed. Not executable in the paper book without premium/IV/strike mids.
trade.thesis: FACT: AUDNZD is at a 5-year extreme because NZDUSD collapsed, not because AUDUSD broke out; AU housing is showing the tightening channel while AONIA still prices about +21.5bp by October and about +59.5bp by August 2027; NZ GDP beat and an India FTA have not reversed NZD; NZ yields are missing; Fed and BoJ hikes are delivered; USDJPY 20-day RV is 11.04 versus AUDNZD 5.09; VIX crushed to 15.44 on 17 Sep; no FX option marks exist. INFERENCE: the market is pricing a one-way RBA-over-RBNZ regime that is internally inconsistent, so the next move is a distribution with a delayed mean-reversion tail and a squeeze tail. Spot is dominated because timing is uncertain and event risk (housing prints, residual RBA path, NZ data, energy, global hike follow-through) is two-sided after realized FX vol on this cross stayed near 5%. Buying USDJPY vol after a +1.41% BoJ day is not the same trade: that realized has already printed. UNKNOWN: 3M ATMF IV, 25-delta risk-reversal, quoted premium, and the RBNZ curve — all must be checked before any OPEN. The paper book therefore HOLDs; the debate trade is still the put.
trade.mispricing: Compressed ~5% realized vol at a 5-year AUDNZD extreme is being treated as evidence that event risk is small. The packet cannot quote implied vol, so this is not an IV-versus-RV call. It is a claim that linear spot understates two-way policy/housing risk and that a long put is the expression that owns the left tail without uncapped squeeze risk.
trade.horizon: 3 months (event window through next RBA/housing/NZ prints)
trade.invalidation: Thesis is wrong if a later frozen packet shows live 3M AUDNZD implied already embedding the reversal tail, or if AUDNZD holds/makes new 5-year highs while AONIA hike pricing remains dominant and housing stops deteriorating. Do not convert this into a spot short to get involved without option mids.

expression_comparison.rationale: Dedicated vol seat. Timing is uncertain and the distribution is two-tailed: housing/RBA disappointment versus a squeeze higher if more AONIA hikes print. A long 3-month OTM AUDNZD put dominates short spot because loss is bounded by premium while the reversal tail is retained. USDJPY spot after the BoJ 1.25% hike is also the wrong linear expression (1-day +1.41%, 20-day RV 11.04) but that realized has already exploded, so buying JPY vol after the jump is not a claim this packet can support without IV. AUDNZD still shows compressed realized vol at a 5-year extreme. Paper remains HOLD because premium/IV/strike mids are absent.

Sidecar is FLAT with last action HOLD; options remain unmarkable, so the book stays HOLD while the debate pitch stays the put.

NZ data or an observable RBNZ path (currently missing) that stops treating NZD as the one-way soft currency.
